text:
jonah: Heads up — trying to land PR 24480 but CI queue is showing ~3h. Rebase window closes at 21:00 PDT. Can someone eyeball and confirm it's safe to hold till the midnight slot?
priya: @jonah I can give it a quick review in 20m. is this mostly test noise or new infra changes?
diego: looks like a flaky e2e on mac that we've been seeing. not blocking from code review side.
jonah: no infra changes, mostly a small routing tweak + unit tests. the mac e2e is the only failing job.
ava: fyi ops scheduled a deploy freeze from 22:00-02:00 PDT for DB migration. we should avoid landing during that window.
priya: okay — if freeze at 22:00 we should either land before 21:30 or wait till after 02:00. can we get a manual canary slot before freeze?
diego: CI capacity is tight. queue length is the problem. maybe rerun the failing mac job with the filtered test to verify. jonah can you kick a single-job rerun?
jonah: kicking targeted rerun now: ```/ci rerun job mac-e2e --filter tests/routing/* ```
ci-bot: queued rerun for job mac-e2e (PR 24480). estimated start ~00:45:00 UTC based on current queue.
priya: that ETA is rough — if it's after freeze we should not rely on it. suggestion: prioritize review + request for approver to merge quickly if rerun passes. who can approve?
ava: I can approve from release side for hotfix small changes. prefer that pr has a green run though.
diego: if rerun still flaky, we can cherry-pick the change into a tiny hotfix branch and land on main with reduced matrix (skip mac e2e), then roll forward. but that requires release sign-off.
jonah: prefer to avoid skipping mac e2e. if @priya ok with quick review and @ava can approve, I'm happy to hold the merge until rerun or until you both say go.
priya: I'll do the review now. quick comments only.
priya: left 2 tiny suggestions in PR comments about naming and a test assertion. nothing blocking.
ava: reviewed the change, +1 from release side. if CI passes rerun, we can merge before the freeze cutoff (21:30 PDT).
jonah: cool — rerun passed (mac job green). thanks team :thumbsup: merging in ~5min during calm window. will watch post-deploy metrics.
ci-bot: PR 24480 merged to main by jonah at 1713460495. CI: all checks passed.
ava: noted — watching metrics as well, ping if anything odd.
diego: nice! thanks for coordinating, everyone.
